name: hc_head
description: Fused hc_head mixer. x is [T,hc_mult,hidden_size]; each token's flattened row is RMS-normalized, mixed by hc_fn (shape [hc_mult,hc_mult*hidden_size], fp32), gated by sigmoid(mixes*hc_scale+hc_base)+hc_eps, and used to form the weighted sum over the hc_mult axis. Arithmetic is float32 and the output is cast to x.dtype. The native dispatcher has fused kernels for hc_mult 2 and 4 and a generic two-kernel path otherwise. Returns a new [T,hidden_size] tensor. Current tests exercise bfloat16 with hc_mult 2/4 and hidden_size 128..7168.
